Week 25 Module Map: The Frontier Cowboy and the Texas Rangers

Quarter 3: The Price of Union

While the frontier war goes on, a new culture forms behind it: vaquero tradition, Anglo practice, and German Hill Country custom merging into the Texas cowboy.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: Vaqueros and Cowboys
  • Lesson 2: Ranches, Raids, and the Rangers

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 25 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 25 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 25 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.
